tier_should.rationale: Strong causal design exploiting political shocks to agency R&D; comprehensive firm-level outcomes; novel decomposition of knowledge, invention, and human capital. Policy-relevant, credible, and well-executed; excellent fit for top innovation/strategy field journals.

tier_will.rationale: Prominent authors and NBER visibility; clean identification and rich data; timely policy relevance. Slightly narrow for top-five generals, but highly competitive at Management Science/AEJ Applied/RAND/REStat.
